data.analysis_summary: The text describes a six-month AI risk ecosystem in which labs, governments, media, experts, public figures, civil-society groups, trackers, and technology companies interact through releases, regulation, reporting, commentary, responses, support, opposition, collaboration, evaluation, and lobbying. The ontology separates high-reach experts and public figures from ordinary persons, and specific organizational actors from the Organization fallback, so social-media simulation can model who speaks, who is reported on, and how narratives spread.
